verdict_raw:
**Verdict: No layout breakage — no overlaps or clipping found; a few minor clarity issues worth a look.**

**(1) Overlapping / clipped UI**
- None found. Toast, "Daytime" pill, floating tool palette, bottom action row, scale bar + Sun chip, zoom cluster, and compass all have clean separation.
- Sidebar cut-off at "Patios & Paths" is normal scroll behavior at the panel edge — acceptable.

**(2) 5-second comprehension for a new user**
- Yes. App purpose (3D backyard design), current state (fence placed, "Design saved" toast, Select tool active), and main affordances (library on left, tool palette, view controls) are readable at a glance.

**(3) Confusing / ambiguous / misplaced / broken-looking**
- **"FPS: 1"** in the status bar is the biggest red flag — it reads as a debug stat and simultaneously signals broken/stalled rendering. Hide from end users (or fix the perf).
- **"Innovate"** button is an unclear label sitting in a tool row with Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze, and it reuses the same lightbulb icon as "Pro Tools" — looks like a mislabeled or duplicated control.
- **The "Sun" chip** floats alone next to the scale bar, detached below the tool row — looks stray, and its relationship to "Sun & Shadow" in the View menu is unclear.
- **"Daytime" pill** floats with no context; it will look orphaned once the toast disappears.
- Minor copy: "Design saved! Check your downloads folder" conflates saving a design with an image export (downloads is where **Capture** output would go) — slightly confusing.

Nothing overlaps, clips, or is functionally broken; the items above are polish/wording fixes.
